description: This file defines the EntityAutocomplete class, a Drupal form element for entity autocompletion, including methods for processing, validation, label extraction, and entity matching.

classes.name: EntityAutocomplete
classes.description: A Drupal form element class providing entity autocomplete functionality, including processing, validation, label extraction, and entity matching.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns default properties for the form element, including target type, selection handler, tags, autocreate, validation, and processing settings.

methods.name: valueCallback
methods.description: Processes the default value and input for the autocomplete element, converting entities to labels and handling target IDs.

methods.name: processEntityAutocomplete
methods.description: Adds autocomplete route parameters and handles autocreate settings for the form element.

methods.name: validateEntityAutocomplete
methods.description: Validates the selected entities, including existence, access, and autocreation, and sets form errors if invalid.

methods.name: matchEntityByTitle
methods.description: Finds an entity ID based on a string input, handling multiple matches and errors.

methods.name: getEntityLabels
methods.description: Converts an array of entity objects into a comma-separated string of labels, checking view access.

methods.name: extractEntityIdFromAutocompleteInput
methods.description: Extracts the entity ID from an autocomplete label string.
